policy: Cases are an inventory of required scenarios, not claims of passing tests. Missing evidence blocks release. kind separates what is tested and how it gates: execution cases are executable checks of browser behaviour and gate 0.5.0 (P0); framework cases check the completeness of catalogs and mappings; process cases are assurance reviews (SBOM, Top 10, SCVS, SAMM, patch cadence) that gate release candidates, not alpha development. evidence lists the suite (or tool:<script>) and the PASS marker that prove a case; the r3 gate requires every marker in the current run. A remaining scenario prefixed [rc] is deferred to the release candidate and does not block r3.
